figurative_meaning_bn: অনিচ্ছুকভাবে সত্যকথা প্রকাশ করতে বাধ্য হওয়া
figurative_meaning_en: Being compelled to reveal the truth reluctantly
similar_in_english: let the cat out of the bag
example_sentences_in_bangla: পুলিশের চাপে সে মুখ খুলে সব সত্যি বলে দিল।
বন্ধুর জিজ্ঞাসায় অনিচ্ছুকভাবে মুখ খুলল সে।
example_sentences_in_english: Under police pressure, he opened his mouth and revealed everything.
Reluctantly, he opened up when his friend asked.
note: This idiom reflects everyday Bengali expressions of forced disclosure.
